Liam was nine. Every morning it was the same fight: "I'm NOT going!" Slammed doors. Tears. Mom crying in one room, Liam crying in another. She thought it was rebellion.

Then she found a note under his pillow: "I'm scared I'll mess up at school and everyone…"

It wasn't rebellion. It was fear. 💔 So often anger is just worry in disguise.

"Fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord." Ephesians 6:4

So the next morning, Liam's mom didn't fight back. She knelt down and said, "You don't have to fight me. Tell me what's scary." And he did. ❤️ When a child feels safe, honour grows and the door can open, one small step at a time.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
